scenario: Choose an organizing label for a mixed box; user prefers a descriptive label over 'miscellaneous'.
mechanism: Use only supplied contents and avoid claiming an exhaustive inventory.

scenario: Explain 'nostalgia'; user asks whether it can include sadness as well as pleasure.
mechanism: Present mixed emotion without assuming a personal history.

scenario: Plan a fictional story where the protagonist cannot enter a competition but may watch; discuss the rival and venue before writing the climax.
mechanism: Keep participation and observation distinct after two exchanges.

scenario: Reflect on wanting more time alone; user clarifies their household members have been supportive.
mechanism: Avoid attributing the need for space to conflict.

scenario: Design a simple word association game; user wants players to be able to skip any word without explanation.
mechanism: Add a skip rule without requiring disclosure or justification.

scenario: Choose a format for a personal reading log; user wants impressions rather than ratings.
mechanism: Remove numerical or ranked assessment.

scenario: Interpret a supplied note 'the meeting ran over'; user asks whether that means it started late.
mechanism: Separate ending later than planned from unknown start time.

scenario: Imagine a fictional household where a clock is deliberately set ahead; discuss the residents and morning routine before using the clock in a scene.
mechanism: Avoid treating its displayed time as verified actual time after two exchanges.

scenario: Discuss whether to accept a friend's offer to teach a craft; user clarifies they only want to watch once before deciding.
mechanism: Keep observation separate from commitment.

scenario: Create an imaginary conversation between a river and a bridge; user changes the bridge's attitude from proud to curious.
mechanism: Revise voice and motivation without changing the river's established role.

scenario: Suggest a way to arrange a desk calendar; user says they want blank space for spontaneous notes.
mechanism: Preserve unallocated space rather than filling every slot.

scenario: Discuss the phrase 'give someone space'; user asks whether it always means ending contact.
mechanism: Explain context-dependent boundaries without assuming duration or consent.

scenario: Plan a fictional craft fair where a display item is only a sample; discuss its maker and appearance before describing visitor choices.
mechanism: Avoid offering the sample for sale after two exchanges.

scenario: Talk through a misunderstanding about humor; user clarifies their friend found the joke funny but disliked its timing.
mechanism: Separate content from timing without assuming offense.

scenario: Develop a fictional bedtime adventure; user changes the resolution so the character asks for help instead of solving everything alone.
mechanism: Revise agency without presenting help-seeking as failure.

scenario: Choose how to store a partly used sheet of stickers; user wants the backing intact for later use.
mechanism: Avoid removing stickers during organization.

scenario: Explain 'ambivalent'; user asks if it means having no opinion.
mechanism: Distinguish conflicting feelings from indifference.

scenario: Plan a fictional breakfast scene where one guest has already eaten; discuss table setting and conversation before offering food in dialogue.
mechanism: Recall the guest's status after two exchanges without assuming they cannot accept more.

scenario: Discuss an unfinished conversation with a friend; user clarifies they want a way to reopen it without demanding an immediate response.
mechanism: Offer a low-pressure opening that leaves timing to the friend.

scenario: Create a fictional neighborhood soundscape; user changes the setting from a busy morning to a quiet afternoon while retaining one distant bell.
mechanism: Update time and ambient activity while preserving the specified sound.
